app_fee.value: International applicants pay $70 (US dollars); the Doctor of Physical Therapy program is the only exception, at $200.
app_fee.quote: Application fees are $60 for domestic students and $70 for international students (US dollars)

fee_waiver.value: Waivers go only to current Auburn graduate students, Auburn employees, active-duty military and dual-program applicants, not to international applicants in general.
fee_waiver.quote: The following applicants are eligible for a fee waiver: | Current Auburn University graduate students enrolled in graduate courses | Full-time Auburn University employees | Active Duty Military with a letter confirming duty

gre_general.value: The Graduate School does not require the GRE; individual programs can, and the program records say which.
gre_general.quote: Auburn University Graduate School does not require the GRE; however programs and departments may require official test scores for admission or for consideration of funding

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT total of 4.5 with at least 4.0 in each section, for tests taken after 21 January 2026.
toefl_min.quote: For all tests after January 21, 2026 | Internet-based TOEFL (iBT26), 4.5 or higher total score with a minimum score of 4.0 on listening, reading, speaking and writing components

also.quote: Internet-based TOEFL (iBT), 79 or higher with minimum scores of 16 on listening, reading, speaking and writing components

ielts_min.value: IELTS overall band of 6.5 or higher.

english_waiver.value: India is not named. Auburn decides exemptions case by case after the transcript arrives, based on the official government language and medium of instruction.
english_waiver.quote: Exemptions to the English proficiency requirement are considered on a case-by-case basis, depending on the official government language and medium of instruction, after submission of the official transcript

notes: Sources: graduate.auburn.edu application, international applicant and GRE waiver pages. Graduate School deadlines are in the Bulletin; the international page says the application deadline is three months prior to term, and departments may set earlier dates. Some departments require higher English scores (international page). Duolingo (115 overall, 110 minimum per section) is also accepted. The Graduate School all-programs page did not render, so the doctoral list is the GRE waiver list. Department pages on cosam.auburn.edu, auburn.edu/cosam and eng.auburn.edu fail TLS verification through the proxy (certificate chain not trusted), so department rules are not checked.
